    64 | function normalizeWhatsAppNumber(value) {
    65 |   let raw = String(value || "").trim();
    66 |   if (!raw) return "";
    67 | 
    68 |   raw = raw.replace(/\s+/g, "").replace(/[()-]/g, "");
    69 | 
    70 |   if (raw.startsWith("whatsapp:")) raw = raw.slice(9);
    71 | 
    72 |   if (raw.startsWith("+")) {
    73 |     const digits = `+${raw.slice(1).replace(/\D/g, "")}`;
    74 |     return /^\+\d{9,15}$/.test(digits) ? digits : "";
    75 |   }
    76 | 
    77 |   const digitsOnly = raw.replace(/\D/g, "");
    78 |   if (!digitsOnly) return "";
    79 | 
    80 |   if (digitsOnly.startsWith("27") && digitsOnly.length === 11) {
    81 |     return `+${digitsOnly}`;
    82 |   }
    83 | 
    84 |   if (digitsOnly.startsWith("0") && digitsOnly.length === 10) {
    85 |     return `+27${digitsOnly.slice(1)}`;
    86 |   }
    87 | 
    88 |   if (digitsOnly.length >= 9 && digitsOnly.length <= 15) {
    89 |     return `+${digitsOnly}`;
    90 |   }
    91 | 
    92 |   return "";
    93 | }

   133 | function readSignupCache(key) {
   134 |   if (typeof window === "undefined" || !key) return null;
   135 |   try {
   136 |     const raw = window.sessionStorage.getItem(`signup_cache__${key}`);
   137 |     if (!raw) return null;
   138 |     const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
   139 |     return {
   140 |       selectedWeeks: Array.isArray(parsed?.selectedWeeks)
   141 |         ? parsed.selectedWeeks.filter(Boolean)
   142 |         : [],
   143 |       paidWeeks: Array.isArray(parsed?.paidWeeks)
   144 |         ? parsed.paidWeeks.filter(Boolean)
   145 |         : [],
   146 |       reminderPreference: String(parsed?.reminderPreference || "17:00"),
   147 |     };
   148 |   } catch (error) {
   149 |     console.warn("Signup cache read skipped:", error);
   150 |     return null;
   151 |   }
   152 | }

   260 | function mergeMatchSignupSettings(raw = {}) {
   261 |   const defaultChallenge = DEFAULT_MATCH_SIGNUP_SETTINGS.challenge;
   262 |   const rawChallenge = raw?.challenge || {};
   263 | 
   264 |   const weeklyDay = Number(raw?.weeklyDay);
   265 |   const weeklyPrice = Number(raw?.weeklyPrice);
   266 |   const challengeMaxPlayers = Number(rawChallenge?.maxPlayers);
   267 |   const challengePrice = Number(rawChallenge?.price);
   268 | 
   269 |   return {
   270 |     weeklyDay: Number.isInteger(weeklyDay) && weeklyDay >= 0 && weeklyDay <= 6
   271 |       ? weeklyDay
   272 |       : DEFAULT_MATCH_SIGNUP_SETTINGS.weeklyDay,
   273 |     weeklyPrice: Number.isFinite(weeklyPrice) && weeklyPrice > 0
   274 |       ? weeklyPrice
   275 |       : DEFAULT_MATCH_SIGNUP_SETTINGS.weeklyPrice,
   276 |     challenge: {
   277 |       enabled: typeof rawChallenge?.enabled === "boolean"
   278 |         ? rawChallenge.enabled
   279 |         : defaultChallenge.enabled,
   280 |       title: String(rawChallenge?.title || defaultChallenge.title || "Challenge").trim() || "Challenge",
   281 |       date: String(rawChallenge?.date || defaultChallenge.date || "").trim(),
   282 |       maxPlayers: CHALLENGE_PLAYER_LIMIT_OPTIONS.includes(challengeMaxPlayers)

   285 |       price: Number.isFinite(challengePrice) && challengePrice > 0
   286 |         ? challengePrice

   334 | function getPrimarySignupScopeMonth() {

   353 | function getMonthWednesdays({ visibleOnly = true, settings = DEFAULT_MATCH_SIGNUP_SETTINGS } = {}) {
   354 |   const mergedSettings = mergeMatchSignupSettings(settings);
   355 |   const now = new Date();
   356 |   const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
   357 |   const shouldShiftToNextMonth = today.getDate() >= 25;
   358 | 
   359 |   const monthTargets = [];
   360 | 
   361 |   monthTargets.push({
   362 |     year: now.getFullYear(),
   363 |     month: now.getMonth(),
   364 |     includeOnlyFuture: visibleOnly,
   365 |   });
   366 | 
   367 |   if (shouldShiftToNextMonth) {
   368 |     monthTargets.push({
   369 |       year: now.getMonth() === 11 ? now.getFullYear() + 1 : now.getFullYear(),
   370 |       month: (now.getMonth() + 1) % 12,
   371 |       includeOnlyFuture: false,
   372 |     });
   373 |   }
   374 | 
   375 |   const byId = new Map();
   376 | 
   377 |   monthTargets.forEach(({ year, month, includeOnlyFuture }) => {
   378 |     const d = new Date(year, month, 1);
   379 | 
   380 |     while (d.getMonth() === month) {
   381 |       const candidate = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());
   382 |       const isTargetWeekday = candidate.getDay() === Number(mergedSettings.weeklyDay);
   383 |       const shouldInclude = includeOnlyFuture ? candidate >= today : true;
   384 | 
   385 |       if (isTargetWeekday && shouldInclude) {
   386 |         const matchDay = buildMatchDayFromDate(candidate, {
   387 |           type: "weekly",
   388 |           title: getWeekdayName(mergedSettings.weeklyDay),
   389 |           maxPlayers: MAX_PLAYERS,
   390 |           costPerGame: mergedSettings.weeklyPrice,
   391 |         });
   392 |         byId.set(matchDay.id, matchDay);
   393 |       }
   394 | 
   395 |       d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);
   396 |     }
   397 |   });
   398 | 
   399 |   const challenge = mergedSettings.challenge || {};
   400 |   if (challenge.enabled && challenge.date) {
   401 |     const challengeDate = new Date(`${challenge.date}T12:00:00`);
   402 |     if (!Number.isNaN(challengeDate.getTime())) {
   403 |       const shouldIncludeChallenge = visibleOnly
   404 |         ? challengeDate >= today
   405 |         : true;
   406 | 
   407 |       if (shouldIncludeChallenge) {
   408 |         const challengeMatchDay = buildMatchDayFromDate(challengeDate, {
   409 |           id: challenge.date,
   410 |           isChallenge: true,
   411 |           title: challenge.title || "Challenge",
   412 |           maxPlayers: challenge.maxPlayers,
   413 |           costPerGame: challenge.price,
   414 |         });
   415 |         byId.set(challengeMatchDay.id, challengeMatchDay);
   416 |       }
   417 |     }
   418 |   }
   419 | 
   420 |   return Array.from(byId.values()).sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date);
   421 | }

   423 | function getCalendarMonthData(weeks = []) {
   424 |   const firstWeekDate =
   425 |     Array.isArray(weeks) && weeks.length > 0 ? weeks[0].date : null;
   426 | 
   427 |   const baseDate = firstWeekDate instanceof Date ? firstWeekDate : new Date();
   428 |   const year = baseDate.getFullYear();
   429 |   const month = baseDate.getMonth();
   430 | 
   431 |   const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1);
   432 |   const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
   433 |   const startWeekday = firstDay.getDay();
   434 | 
   435 |   const cells = [];
   436 | 
   437 |   for (let i = 0; i < startWeekday; i += 1) cells.push(null);
   438 | 
   439 |   for (let day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day += 1) {
   440 |     const date = new Date(year, month, day);
   441 |     const id = `${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(
   442 |       day
   443 |     ).padStart(2, "0")}`;
   444 | 
   445 |     cells.push({
   446 |       id,
   447 |       day,
   448 |       weekday: date.getDay(),
   449 |       date,
   450 |     });
   451 |   }
   452 | 
   453 |   return {
   454 |     monthLabel: firstDay.toLocaleDateString("en-ZA", {
   455 |       month: "long",
   456 |       year: "numeric",
   457 |     }),
   458 |     cells,
   459 |   };
   460 | }

   462 | function getCalendarMonthsData(weeks = []) {
   463 |   const safeWeeks = Array.isArray(weeks) ? weeks : [];
   464 |   const monthKeys = [];
   465 | 
   466 |   safeWeeks.forEach((week) => {
   467 |     if (!(week?.date instanceof Date)) return;
   468 |     const key = `${week.date.getFullYear()}-${String(week.date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`;
   469 |     if (!monthKeys.includes(key)) monthKeys.push(key);
   470 |   });
   471 | 
   472 |   if (!monthKeys.length) return [getCalendarMonthData([])];
   473 | 
   474 |   return monthKeys.map((key) => {
   475 |     const [yearRaw, monthRaw] = key.split("-");
   476 |     const year = Number(yearRaw);
   477 |     const month = Number(monthRaw) - 1;
   478 | 
   479 |     return getCalendarMonthData([
   480 |       {
   481 |         date: new Date(year, month, 1),
   482 |       },
   483 |     ]);
   484 |   });
   485 | }

    64 | function normalizeWhatsAppNumber(value) {
    65 |   let raw = String(value || "").trim();
    66 |   if (!raw) return "";
    67 | 
    68 |   raw = raw.replace(/\s+/g, "").replace(/[()-]/g, "");
    69 | 
    70 |   if (raw.startsWith("whatsapp:")) raw = raw.slice(9);
    71 | 
    72 |   if (raw.startsWith("+")) {
    73 |     const digits = `+${raw.slice(1).replace(/\D/g, "")}`;
    74 |     return /^\+\d{9,15}$/.test(digits) ? digits : "";
    75 |   }
    76 | 
    77 |   const digitsOnly = raw.replace(/\D/g, "");
    78 |   if (!digitsOnly) return "";
    79 | 
    80 |   if (digitsOnly.startsWith("27") && digitsOnly.length === 11) {
    81 |     return `+${digitsOnly}`;
    82 |   }
    83 | 
    84 |   if (digitsOnly.startsWith("0") && digitsOnly.length === 10) {
    85 |     return `+27${digitsOnly.slice(1)}`;
    86 |   }
    87 | 
    88 |   if (digitsOnly.length >= 9 && digitsOnly.length <= 15) {
    89 |     return `+${digitsOnly}`;
    90 |   }
    91 | 
    92 |   return "";
    93 | }

   133 | function readSignupCache(key) {

   135 |   try {
   136 |     const raw = window.sessionStorage.getItem(`signup_cache__${key}`);
   137 |     if (!raw) return null;

   139 |     return {
   140 |       selectedWeeks: Array.isArray(parsed?.selectedWeeks)
   141 |         ? parsed.selectedWeeks.filter(Boolean)
   142 |         : [],
   143 |       paidWeeks: Array.isArray(parsed?.paidWeeks)
   144 |         ? parsed.paidWeeks.filter(Boolean)
   145 |         : [],
   146 |       reminderPreference: String(parsed?.reminderPreference || "17:00"),
   147 |     };

   353 | function getMonthWednesdays({ visibleOnly = true, settings = DEFAULT_MATCH_SIGNUP_SETTINGS } = {}) {
   354 |   const mergedSettings = mergeMatchSignupSettings(settings);
   355 |   const now = new Date();
   356 |   const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
   357 |   const shouldShiftToNextMonth = today.getDate() >= 25;
   358 | 
   359 |   const monthTargets = [];
   360 | 
   361 |   monthTargets.push({
   362 |     year: now.getFullYear(),
   363 |     month: now.getMonth(),
   364 |     includeOnlyFuture: visibleOnly,
   365 |   });
   366 | 
   367 |   if (shouldShiftToNextMonth) {
   368 |     monthTargets.push({
   369 |       year: now.getMonth() === 11 ? now.getFullYear() + 1 : now.getFullYear(),
   370 |       month: (now.getMonth() + 1) % 12,
   371 |       includeOnlyFuture: false,
   372 |     });
   373 |   }
   374 | 
   375 |   const byId = new Map();
   376 | 
   377 |   monthTargets.forEach(({ year, month, includeOnlyFuture }) => {
   378 |     const d = new Date(year, month, 1);
   379 | 
   380 |     while (d.getMonth() === month) {
   381 |       const candidate = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());
   382 |       const isTargetWeekday = candidate.getDay() === Number(mergedSettings.weeklyDay);
   383 |       const shouldInclude = includeOnlyFuture ? candidate >= today : true;
   384 | 
   385 |       if (isTargetWeekday && shouldInclude) {
   386 |         const matchDay = buildMatchDayFromDate(candidate, {
   387 |           type: "weekly",
   388 |           title: getWeekdayName(mergedSettings.weeklyDay),
   389 |           maxPlayers: MAX_PLAYERS,
   390 |           costPerGame: mergedSettings.weeklyPrice,
   391 |         });
   392 |         byId.set(matchDay.id, matchDay);
   393 |       }
   394 | 
   395 |       d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);
   396 |     }
   397 |   });
   398 | 
   399 |   const challenge = mergedSettings.challenge || {};
   400 |   if (challenge.enabled && challenge.date) {
   401 |     const challengeDate = new Date(`${challenge.date}T12:00:00`);
   402 |     if (!Number.isNaN(challengeDate.getTime())) {
   403 |       const shouldIncludeChallenge = visibleOnly
   404 |         ? challengeDate >= today
   405 |         : true;
   406 | 
   407 |       if (shouldIncludeChallenge) {
   408 |         const challengeMatchDay = buildMatchDayFromDate(challengeDate, {
   409 |           id: challenge.date,
   410 |           isChallenge: true,
   411 |           title: challenge.title || "Challenge",
   412 |           maxPlayers: challenge.maxPlayers,
   413 |           costPerGame: challenge.price,
   414 |         });
   415 |         byId.set(challengeMatchDay.id, challengeMatchDay);
   416 |       }
   417 |     }
   418 |   }
   419 | 
   420 |   return Array.from(byId.values()).sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date);
   421 | }

   423 | function getCalendarMonthData(weeks = []) {
   424 |   const firstWeekDate =
   425 |     Array.isArray(weeks) && weeks.length > 0 ? weeks[0].date : null;
   426 | 
   427 |   const baseDate = firstWeekDate instanceof Date ? firstWeekDate : new Date();
   428 |   const year = baseDate.getFullYear();
   429 |   const month = baseDate.getMonth();
   430 | 
   431 |   const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1);
   432 |   const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
   433 |   const startWeekday = firstDay.getDay();
   434 | 
   435 |   const cells = [];
   436 | 
   437 |   for (let i = 0; i < startWeekday; i += 1) cells.push(null);
   438 | 
   439 |   for (let day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day += 1) {
   440 |     const date = new Date(year, month, day);
   441 |     const id = `${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(
   442 |       day
   443 |     ).padStart(2, "0")}`;
   444 | 
   445 |     cells.push({
   446 |       id,
   447 |       day,
   448 |       weekday: date.getDay(),
   449 |       date,
   450 |     });
   451 |   }
   452 | 
   453 |   return {
   454 |     monthLabel: firstDay.toLocaleDateString("en-ZA", {
   455 |       month: "long",
   456 |       year: "numeric",
   457 |     }),
   458 |     cells,
   459 |   };
   460 | }

   462 | function getCalendarMonthsData(weeks = []) {
   463 |   const safeWeeks = Array.isArray(weeks) ? weeks : [];
   464 |   const monthKeys = [];
   465 | 
   466 |   safeWeeks.forEach((week) => {
   467 |     if (!(week?.date instanceof Date)) return;
   468 |     const key = `${week.date.getFullYear()}-${String(week.date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`;
   469 |     if (!monthKeys.includes(key)) monthKeys.push(key);
   470 |   });
   471 | 
   472 |   if (!monthKeys.length) return [getCalendarMonthData([])];
   473 | 
   474 |   return monthKeys.map((key) => {
   475 |     const [yearRaw, monthRaw] = key.split("-");
   476 |     const year = Number(yearRaw);
   477 |     const month = Number(monthRaw) - 1;
   478 | 
   479 |     return getCalendarMonthData([
   480 |       {
   481 |         date: new Date(year, month, 1),
   482 |       },
   483 |     ]);
   484 |   });
   485 | }

   602 | function buildAttendanceFromMatchDayHistory({
   603 |   matchDayHistory = [],
   604 |   identity,
   605 |   displayName,
   606 |   shortName,
   607 | }) {
   608 |   const identityKeys = getIdentityKeys(identity, displayName, shortName);
   609 |   const allMatchDays = new Set();
   610 |   const attendedMatchDays = new Set();

   612 | 
   613 |   (Array.isArray(matchDayHistory) ? matchDayHistory : []).forEach((day) => {
   614 |     const seasonId = String(day?.seasonId || "").trim();
   615 |     const localDayId = String(day?.id || day?.matchDayId || "").trim();

   617 | 
   618 |     const compositeDayId = seasonId ? `${seasonId}__${localDayId}` : localDayId;
   619 |     allMatchDays.add(compositeDayId);
   620 | 
   621 |     const playerAppearances = Array.isArray(day?.playerAppearances)
   622 |       ? day.playerAppearances
   623 |       : [];

   626 |       const rowKeys = uniqueStrings([
   627 |         entry?.playerId,
   628 |         entry?.playerName,

   630 |         entry?.displayName,

   632 |           entry?.playerName || entry?.shortName || entry?.displayName || ""
   633 |         ),

   635 |           entry?.playerName || entry?.shortName || entry?.displayName || ""
   636 |         ),
   637 |       ]).map(normKey);

   639 |       return rowKeys.some((k) => identityKeys.includes(k));
   640 |     });

   642 |     if (!matchingEntry) return;

   644 |     attendedMatchDays.add(compositeDayId);
   645 | 
   646 |     const directMatchesPlayed = Number(
   647 |       matchingEntry?.matchesPlayed ?? matchingEntry?.gamesPlayed
   648 |     );
   649 | 
   650 |     if (Number.isFinite(directMatchesPlayed) && directMatchesPlayed > 0) {

   656 |           matchingEntry?.wasInGame ??

   661 |         playedFlag === "true" ||
   662 |         playedFlag === "1" ||
   663 |         playedFlag === "yes"
   664 |       ) {
   665 |         gamesPlayed += 1;
   666 |       }

   668 |   });

   670 |   const attended = attendedMatchDays.size;
   671 |   const total = allMatchDays.size;

   673 |

   683 | function buildAttendanceFromAttendanceCollection({

   731 |   );
   732 |

   737 |   const gamesPlayed = playerRows.reduce((sum, row) => {

   739 |     if (Number.isFinite(directValue) && directValue > 0) return sum + directValue;
   740 | 
   741 |     const playedFlag = String(
   742 |       row.played ?? row.didPlay ?? row.wasInGame ?? ""
   743 |     ).toLowerCase();
   744 | 
   745 |     if (
   746 |       playedFlag === "true" ||
   747 |       playedFlag === "1" ||
   748 |       playedFlag === "yes"
   749 |     ) {
   750 |       return sum + 1;
   751 |     }
   752 | 
   753 |     return sum;
   754 |   }, 0);
   755 | 
   756 |   return {
   757 |     loading: false,

   791 | function statusFromWeekState(selectedWeeks, paidWeeks) {
   792 |   const selected = uniqueWeekIds(selectedWeeks);

  2027 |   const baseAbbrevFromName = (name) => {
  2028 |     const cleanName = String(name || "").trim();
  2029 |     const upper = cleanName.toUpperCase();
  2030 |     const words = upper.replace(/[^A-Z0-9 ]/g, " ").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  2031 | 
  2032 |     if (!words.length) return "";
  2033 | 
  2034 |     const compact = words.join("");
  2035 | 
  2036 |     if (/^DARK/.test(compact)) return "DARK";
  2037 |     if (/^LIGHT/.test(compact)) return "LIGT";
  2038 | 
  2039 |     if (words[0] === "MAN" || words[0] === "MANCHESTER") {
  2040 |       const second = words[1] || "";
  2041 |       if (second.startsWith("C")) return "MCI";
  2042 |       if (second.startsWith("U")) return "MUN";
  2043 |     }
  2044 | 
  2045 |     if (compact.startsWith("MADRID")) return "MAD";
  2046 |     if (compact.startsWith("BARCELONA")) return "BAR";
  2047 |     if (compact.startsWith("AJAX")) return "AJA";
  2048 | 
  2049 |     if (words.length >= 2) {
  2050 |       const initials = words.map((word) => word[0]).join("");
  2051 |       if (initials.length >= 3) return initials.slice(0, 4);
  2052 |     }
  2053 | 
  2054 |     return compact.slice(0, compact.length >= 4 ? 4 : 3);
  2055 |   };

  2057 |   const makeUniqueTeamAbbrev = (teamId, nextName, teamsList = sourceTeams) => {
  2058 |     const preferred = normalizeAbbrev(baseAbbrevFromName(nextName));
  2059 |     if (!preferred) return "";
  2060 | 
  2061 |     const taken = new Set(
  2062 |       (teamsList || [])
  2063 |         .filter((team) => team.id !== teamId)
  2064 |         .map((team) => normalizeAbbrev(team.abbrev || baseAbbrevFromName(team.label)))
  2065 |         .filter(Boolean)
  2066 |     );
  2067 | 
  2068 |     if (!taken.has(preferred)) return preferred;
  2069 | 
  2070 |     const compact = String(nextName || "").toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, "");
  2071 |     const candidates = [
  2072 |       compact.slice(0, 4),
  2073 |       compact.slice(0, 3),
  2074 |       ...compact.split("").map((_, index) => `${preferred.slice(0, 3)}${compact[index] || ""}`),
  2075 |     ]
  2076 |       .map(normalizeAbbrev)
  2077 |       .filter((value) => value.length >= 3 && value.length <= 4);
  2078 | 
  2079 |     return candidates.find((candidate) => candidate && !taken.has(candidate)) || preferred;
  2080 |   };

  3103 |     }

  3107 |       return { dateLabel: nextTeamsheetWeekId, scheduleLabel: "" };
  3108 |     }
  3109 |

  3111 |       day: "2-digit",
  3112 |       month: "short",
  3113 |       year: "numeric",
  3114 |     });
  3115 | 
  3116 |     const today = new Date();
  3117 |     const tomorrow = new Date();
  3118 |     tomorrow.setDate(today.getDate() + 1);
  3119 | 
  3120 |     const ymd = (date) => date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  3121 |     const gameYmd = ymd(d);
  3122 | 
  3123 |     let dayLabel = d.toLocaleDateString("en-ZA", { weekday: "long" });

  1449 |     const normalizeTeamsAgainstPlayers = (prevTeams) =>
  1450 |       prevTeams.map((t) => {
  1451 |         const nextPlayers = (t.players || []).map((entry) => {
  1452 |           if (playersById.has(entry)) return entry;
  1453 |           const resolved = resolvePlayerIdFromString(allPlayers, entry);
  1454 |           return resolved || entry;
  1455 |         });
  1456 | 
  1457 |         const seen = new Set();
  1458 |         const deduped = [];
  1459 |         for (const x of nextPlayers) {
  1460 |           if (!x) continue;
  1461 |           if (seen.has(x)) continue;
  1462 |           seen.add(x);
  1463 |           deduped.push(x);
  1464 |         }
  1465 | 
  1466 |         let captainId = t.captainId || null;
  1467 |         if (!captainId && t.captain) {
  1468 |           const resolvedCaptain = resolvePlayerIdFromString(allPlayers, t.captain);
  1469 |           if (resolvedCaptain) captainId = resolvedCaptain;
  1470 |         }
  1471 | 
  1472 |         return { ...t, players: deduped, captainId };
  1473 |       });
  1474 | 
  1475 |     setLocalLeagueTeams((prev) => normalizeTeamsAgainstPlayers(prev));
  1476 |     setLocalFiveVFiveTeams((prev) => normalizeTeamsAgainstPlayers(prev));
  1477 |   }, [allPlayers, playersById]);

  1586 | function buildCameraPlayersFromLineupSnapshot(snapshot, teamId) {

  1896 | function buildClubOfficialScheduledFinishISO(playTime, startISO) {
  1897 |   const start = new Date(startISO || Date.now());
  1898 |   const match = String(playTime || "").match(
  1899 |     /(?:^|\D)([01]?\d|2[0-3]):([0-5]\d)(?:\D|$)/

  1902 |   if (!match || !Number.isFinite(start.getTime())) return null;
  1903 |

  1905 |   scheduledStart.setHours(Number(match[1]), Number(match[2]), 0, 0);
  1906 |

  1908 |   scheduledFinish.setMinutes(scheduledFinish.getMinutes() + 60);
  1909 |

  1913 | function buildClubScheduledFinishISO(playTime, startISO, fallbackSeconds) {
  1914 |   const start = new Date(startISO || Date.now());
  1915 | 
  1916 |   if (!Number.isFinite(start.getTime())) {
  1917 |     return addSecondsToISO(startISO, fallbackSeconds);
  1918 |   }
  1919 | 
  1920 |   const officialFinishISO = buildClubOfficialScheduledFinishISO(
  1921 |     playTime,
  1922 |     startISO
  1923 |   );
  1924 | 
  1925 |   if (!officialFinishISO) {
  1926 |     const recommended = roundDateToNearestQuarterHour(
  1927 |       new Date(start.getTime() + Math.max(0, Number(fallbackSeconds || 3600)) * 1000)
  1928 |     );
  1929 | 
  1930 |     return recommended?.toISOString() || addSecondsToISO(startISO, fallbackSeconds);
  1931 |   }
  1932 | 
  1933 |   const officialFinish = new Date(officialFinishISO);
  1934 |   const scheduledStart = new Date(officialFinish);
  1935 |   scheduledStart.setMinutes(scheduledStart.getMinutes() - 60);
  1936 | 
  1937 |   // Treat kickoff as part of the scheduled session when it begins
  1938 |   // no more than 30 minutes before the scheduled start and no more
  1939 |   // than 30 minutes after it.
  1940 |   const earliestScheduledKickoff = scheduledStart.getTime() - 30 * 60 * 1000;
  1941 |   const latestScheduledKickoff = scheduledStart.getTime() + 30 * 60 * 1000;
  1942 |   const kickoffIsNearSchedule =
  1943 |     start.getTime() >= earliestScheduledKickoff &&
  1944 |     start.getTime() <= latestScheduledKickoff;
  1945 | 
  1946 |   if (kickoffIsNearSchedule && officialFinish.getTime() > start.getTime()) {
  1947 |     return officialFinish.toISOString();
  1948 |   }
  1949 | 
  1950 |   const recommended = roundDateToNearestQuarterHour(
  1951 |     new Date(start.getTime() + 60 * 60 * 1000)
  1952 |   );
  1953 | 
  1954 |   return recommended?.toISOString() || addSecondsToISO(startISO, fallbackSeconds);
  1955 | }

  2019 | function parseClubWeeklyWindow(text) {
  2020 |   const raw = String(text || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  2021 |   if (!raw) return null;
  2022 | 
  2023 |   const dayMap = {
  2024 |     sunday: 0, sundays: 0,
  2025 |     monday: 1, mondays: 1,
  2026 |     tuesday: 2, tuesdays: 2,
  2027 |     wednesday: 3, wednesdays: 3,
  2028 |     thursday: 4, thursdays: 4,
  2029 |     friday: 5, fridays: 5,
  2030 |     saturday: 6, saturdays: 6,
  2031 |   };
  2032 | 
  2033 |   const dayKey = Object.keys(dayMap).find((key) => raw.includes(key));
  2034 |   const timeMatch = raw.match(/(\d{1,2})[:h](\d{2})(?:\s*[–-]\s*(\d{1,2})[:h](\d{2}))?/);
  2035 | 
  2036 |   if (!dayKey || !timeMatch) return null;
  2037 | 
  2038 |   const [, sh, sm, rawEh, rawEm] = timeMatch;
  2039 |   const eh = rawEh || String(Number(sh) + 2);
  2040 |   const em = rawEm || sm;
  2041 |   return {
  2042 |     day: dayMap[dayKey],
  2043 |     startMinutes: Number(sh) * 60 + Number(sm),
  2044 |     endMinutes: Number(eh) * 60 + Number(em),
  2045 |   };
  2046 | }
  2047 | 
  2048 | function isInsideClubWeeklyWindow(weeklyPlayTime, now = new Date()) {
  2049 |   const windowInfo = parseClubWeeklyWindow(weeklyPlayTime);
  2050 |   if (!windowInfo) return false;
  2051 | 
  2052 |   const currentDay = now.getDay();
  2053 |   const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
  2054 | 
  2055 |   // 30-minute grace before and after the official window.
  2056 |   return (
  2057 |     currentDay === windowInfo.day &&
  2058 |     currentMinutes >= windowInfo.startMinutes - 30 &&
  2059 |     currentMinutes <= windowInfo.endMinutes + 30
  2060 |   );
  2061 | }

   258 | function buildPlayerResolver(players = []) {

   267 |

   271 |     set.add(normKey(slugFromLooseName(pretty)));
   272 |

   274 |     if (first) {
   275 |       firstNameCounts.set(first, (firstNameCounts.get(first) || 0) + 1);
   276 |       set.add(first);
   277 |     }
   278 |   };
   279 | 
   280 |   players.forEach((p) => {
   281 |     const keys = new Set();

   288 |     keys.forEach((k) => {
   289 |       if (k && !byAny.has(k)) {

  1893 | function formatSeconds(s) {
  1894 |   const v = typeof s === "number" && !Number.isNaN(s) ? s : 0;
  1895 |   const m = Math.floor(v / 60)
  1896 |     .toString()
  1897 |     .padStart(2, "0");
  1898 |   const sec = (v % 60).toString().padStart(2, "0");
  1899 |   return `${m}:${sec}`;
  1900 | }
  1901 | 
  1902 | function formatEventClock(totalMatchSeconds, secondsLeft, eventTimeSeconds) {
  1903 |   const elapsed =
  1904 |     typeof eventTimeSeconds === "number"
  1905 |       ? eventTimeSeconds
  1906 |       : (totalMatchSeconds || 0) - (secondsLeft || 0);
  1907 |   return formatSeconds(elapsed);
  1908 | }

  1910 | function getRotationDue(matchSeconds, secondsLeft) {
  1911 |   const elapsed = Math.max((matchSeconds || 0) - (secondsLeft || 0), 0);
  1912 |   const nextBoundary =
  1913 |     Math.floor(elapsed / ROTATION_INTERVAL_SECONDS) * ROTATION_INTERVAL_SECONDS +
  1914 |     ROTATION_INTERVAL_SECONDS;
  1915 |   const remaining = Math.max(nextBoundary - elapsed, 0);
  1916 | 
  1917 |   return {
  1918 |     elapsed,
  1919 |     remaining,
  1920 |     nextBoundary,
  1921 |   };
  1922 | }

  1924 | function getLocalDateKey(dateInput = new Date()) {
  1925 |   const d = dateInput instanceof Date ? dateInput : new Date(dateInput || Date.now());
  1926 |   const safe = Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? new Date() : d;
  1927 |   const year = safe.getFullYear();
  1928 |   const month = String(safe.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  1929 |   const day = String(safe.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  1930 |   return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
  1931 | }

  1935 |   if (raw.includes("7")) return "7v7";

   258 | function buildPlayerResolver(players = []) {
   259 |   const byAny = new Map();
   260 |   const firstNameCounts = new Map();
   261 | 
   262 |   const addKey = (set, value) => {
   263 |     const raw = String(value || "").trim();
   264 |     if (!raw) return;
   265 | 
   266 |     const pretty = toTitleCaseLoose(raw);
   267 | 
   268 |     set.add(normKey(raw));
   269 |     set.add(normKey(pretty));
   270 |     set.add(normKey(slugFromLooseName(raw)));
   271 |     set.add(normKey(slugFromLooseName(pretty)));
   272 | 
   273 |     const first = normKey(firstNameOf(pretty));
   274 |     if (first) {
   275 |       firstNameCounts.set(first, (firstNameCounts.get(first) || 0) + 1);
   276 |       set.add(first);
   277 |     }
   278 |   };
   279 | 
   280 |   players.forEach((p) => {
   281 |     const keys = new Set();
   282 | 
   283 |     addKey(keys, p.id);
   284 |     addKey(keys, p.fullName);
   285 |     addKey(keys, p.shortName);
   286 |     (p.aliases || []).forEach((a) => addKey(keys, a));
   287 | 
   288 |     keys.forEach((k) => {
   289 |       if (k && !byAny.has(k)) {
   290 |         byAny.set(k, p);
   291 |       }
   292 |     });
   293 |   });
   294 | 
   295 |   function resolve(rawLabel) {
   296 |     const raw = toTitleCaseLoose(rawLabel || "");
   297 |     const k = normKey(raw);
   298 |     if (!k) {
   299 |       return {
   300 |         player: null,
   301 |         canonical: "",
   302 |         compact: "",
   303 |       };
   304 |     }
   305 | 
   306 |     const exact = byAny.get(k);
   307 |     if (exact) {
   308 |       const canonical = exact.fullName || raw;
   309 |       const compact =
   310 |         String(exact.shortName || "").trim() ||
   311 |         firstNameOf(canonical) ||
   312 |         canonical;
   313 | 
   314 |       return {
   315 |         player: exact,
   316 |         canonical,
   317 |         compact,
   318 |       };
   319 |     }
   320 | 
   321 |     const slug = normKey(slugFromLooseName(raw));
   322 |     const bySlug = byAny.get(slug);
   323 |     if (bySlug) {
   324 |       const canonical = bySlug.fullName || raw;
   325 |       const compact =
   326 |         String(bySlug.shortName || "").trim() ||
   327 |         firstNameOf(canonical) ||
   328 |         canonical;
   329 | 
   330 |       return {
   331 |         player: bySlug,
   332 |         canonical,
   333 |         compact,
   334 |       };
   335 |     }
   336 | 
   337 |     const first = normKey(firstNameOf(raw));
   338 |     if (first && firstNameCounts.get(first) === 1) {
   339 |       const candidate = byAny.get(first);
   340 |       if (candidate) {
   341 |         const canonical = candidate.fullName || raw;
   342 |         const compact =
   343 |           String(candidate.shortName || "").trim() ||
   344 |           firstNameOf(canonical) ||
   345 |           canonical;
   346 | 
   347 |         return {
   348 |           player: candidate,
   349 |           canonical,
   350 |           compact,
   351 |         };
   352 |       }
   353 |     }
   354 | 
   355 |     return {
   356 |       player: null,
   357 |       canonical: raw,
   358 |       compact: firstNameOf(raw) || raw,
   359 |     };
   360 |   }
   361 | 
   362 |   return {
   363 |     resolve,
   364 |     canonicalName(raw) {
   365 |       return resolve(raw).canonical;
   366 |     },
   367 |     compactName(raw) {
   368 |       return resolve(raw).compact;
   369 |     },
   370 |     playerKey(raw) {
   371 |       return slugFromLooseName(resolve(raw).canonical || "");
   372 |     },
   373 |   };
   374 | }

   376 | function uniquePlayersNormalized(list = [], canonicalName, playerKeyFor) {
   377 |   const seen = new Set();
   378 |   const out = [];
   379 | 
   380 |   list.forEach((item) => {
   381 |     const pretty = canonicalName(item);
   382 |     const key = playerKeyFor(pretty);
   383 |     if (!pretty || seen.has(key)) return;
   384 |     seen.add(key);
   385 |     out.push(pretty);
   386 |   });
   387 | 
   388 |   return out;
   389 | }

   391 | function removePlayerByKey(list = [], name = "", canonicalName, playerKeyFor) {
   392 |   const targetKey = playerKeyFor(name);
   393 |   return uniquePlayersNormalized(list, canonicalName, playerKeyFor).filter(
   394 |     (item) => playerKeyFor(item) !== targetKey
   395 |   );
   396 | }

   398 | function movePlayerToFront(list = [], name = "", canonicalName, playerKeyFor) {
   399 |   const clean = canonicalName(name);
   400 |   if (!clean) return uniquePlayersNormalized(list, canonicalName, playerKeyFor);
   401 | 
   402 |   return uniquePlayersNormalized(
   403 |     [clean, ...removePlayerByKey(list, clean, canonicalName, playerKeyFor)],
   404 |     canonicalName,
   405 |     playerKeyFor
   406 |   );
   407 | }

   409 | function sanitizeLiveLineupToRegisteredPlayers(
   410 |   lineup,
   411 |   registeredPlayers = [],
   412 |   canonicalName,
   413 |   playerKeyFor,
   414 |   formationMap = FORMATIONS_5,
   415 |   defaultFormationId = DEFAULT_FORMATION_ID_5,
   416 |   options = {}
   417 | ) {
   418 |   const preservePositions =
   419 |     Boolean(options?.preservePositions);
   420 |   const formation =
   421 |     formationMap[lineup?.formationId] || formationMap[defaultFormationId] || Object.values(formationMap)[0];
   422 | 
   423 |   const validRegistered = uniquePlayersNormalized(
   424 |     registeredPlayers || [],
   425 |     canonicalName,
   426 |     playerKeyFor
   427 |   );
   428 |   const validKeys = new Set(validRegistered.map((name) => playerKeyFor(name)));
   429 | 
   430 |   const cleanPositions = {};
   431 |   const usedKeys = new Set();
   432 | 
   433 |   (formation.positions || []).forEach((pos) => {
   434 |     const rawName = lineup?.positions?.[pos.id] || "";
   435 |     const canonical = canonicalName(rawName);
   436 |     const key = playerKeyFor(canonical);
   437 | 
   438 |     if (canonical && validKeys.has(key) && !usedKeys.has(key)) {
   439 |       cleanPositions[pos.id] = canonical;
   440 |       usedKeys.add(key);
   441 |     } else {
   442 |       cleanPositions[pos.id] = null;
   443 |     }
   444 |   });
   445 | 
   446 |   const remainingRegistered = validRegistered.filter(
   447 |     (name) => !usedKeys.has(playerKeyFor(name))
   448 |   );
   449 | 
   450 |   if (!preservePositions) {
   451 |     (formation.positions || []).forEach((pos) => {
   452 |       if (
   453 |         !cleanPositions[pos.id] &&
   454 |         remainingRegistered.length > 0
   455 |       ) {
   456 |         const next = remainingRegistered.shift();
   457 |         cleanPositions[pos.id] = next;
   458 |         usedKeys.add(playerKeyFor(next));
   459 |       }
   460 |     });
   461 |   }
   462 | 
   463 |   const cleanGuests = uniquePlayersNormalized(
   464 |     lineup?.guestPlayers || [],
   465 |     canonicalName,
   466 |     playerKeyFor
   467 |   ).filter(
   468 |     (name) => !usedKeys.has(playerKeyFor(name))
   469 |   );
   470 | 
   471 |   const preservedBench = uniquePlayersNormalized(
   472 |     lineup?.benchSnapshot || [],
   473 |     canonicalName,
   474 |     playerKeyFor
   475 |   ).filter(
   476 |     (name) =>
   477 |       validKeys.has(playerKeyFor(name)) &&
   478 |       !usedKeys.has(playerKeyFor(name))
   479 |   );
   480 | 
   481 |   const preservedBenchKeys = new Set(
   482 |     preservedBench.map((name) =>
   483 |       playerKeyFor(name)
   484 |     )
   485 |   );
   486 | 
   487 |   const missingRegisteredBench =
   488 |     remainingRegistered.filter(
   489 |       (name) =>
   490 |         !preservedBenchKeys.has(
   491 |           playerKeyFor(name)
   492 |         )
   493 |     );
   494 | 
   495 |   return {
   496 |     ...lineup,
   497 |     formationId: formation.id,
   498 |     positions: cleanPositions,
   499 |     guestPlayers: cleanGuests,
   500 |     benchSnapshot: preservePositions
   501 |       ? uniquePlayersNormalized(
   502 |           [
   503 |             ...preservedBench,
   504 |             ...missingRegisteredBench,
   505 |           ],
   506 |           canonicalName,
   507 |           playerKeyFor
   508 |         ).filter(
   509 |           (name) =>
   510 |             !usedKeys.has(playerKeyFor(name))
   511 |         )
   512 |       : remainingRegistered,
   513 |     registeredPlayers: validRegistered,
   514 |   };
   515 | }

   517 | function liveLineupStateEquals(
   518 |   a,
   519 |   b,
   520 |   canonicalName,
   521 |   playerKeyFor,
   522 |   formationMap = FORMATIONS_5,
   523 |   defaultFormationId = DEFAULT_FORMATION_ID_5
   524 | ) {
   525 |   const formationA =
   526 |     formationMap[a?.formationId] || formationMap[defaultFormationId] || Object.values(formationMap)[0];
   527 |   const formationB =
   528 |     formationMap[b?.formationId] || formationMap[defaultFormationId] || Object.values(formationMap)[0];
   529 | 
   530 |   if (formationA.id !== formationB.id) return false;
   531 | 
   532 |   const posIds = new Set([
   533 |     ...(formationA.positions || []).map((p) => p.id),
   534 |     ...(formationB.positions || []).map((p) => p.id),
   535 |   ]);
   536 | 
   537 |   for (const posId of posIds) {
   538 |     if (
   539 |       playerKeyFor(a?.positions?.[posId] || "") !==
   540 |       playerKeyFor(b?.positions?.[posId] || "")
   541 |     ) {
   542 |       return false;
   543 |     }
   544 |   }
   545 | 
   546 |   const aGuests = uniquePlayersNormalized(
   547 |     a?.guestPlayers || [],
   548 |     canonicalName,
   549 |     playerKeyFor
   550 |   );
   551 |   const bGuests = uniquePlayersNormalized(
   552 |     b?.guestPlayers || [],
   553 |     canonicalName,
   554 |     playerKeyFor
   555 |   );
   556 |   if (aGuests.length !== bGuests.length) return false;
   557 |   for (let i = 0; i < aGuests.length; i += 1) {
   558 |     if (playerKeyFor(aGuests[i]) !== playerKeyFor(bGuests[i])) return false;
   559 |   }
   560 | 
   561 |   const aBench = uniquePlayersNormalized(
   562 |     a?.benchSnapshot || [],
   563 |     canonicalName,
   564 |     playerKeyFor
   565 |   );
   566 |   const bBench = uniquePlayersNormalized(
   567 |     b?.benchSnapshot || [],
   568 |     canonicalName,
   569 |     playerKeyFor
   570 |   );
   571 |   if (aBench.length !== bBench.length) return false;
   572 |   for (let i = 0; i < aBench.length; i += 1) {
   573 |     if (playerKeyFor(aBench[i]) !== playerKeyFor(bBench[i])) return false;
   574 |   }
   575 | 
   576 |   return true;
   577 | }

   652 | function roleTagFromPosition(positionIdOrLabel = "") {
   653 |   const key = String(positionIdOrLabel || "").trim().toLowerCase();
   654 | 
   655 |   if (!key) return "";
   656 | 
   657 |   if (
   658 |     key === "gk" ||
   659 |     key.includes("goalkeeper") ||
   660 |     key.includes("keeper") ||
   661 |     key.includes("goalie")
   662 |   ) {
   663 |     return "GK";
   664 |   }
   665 | 
   666 |   if (
   667 |     key === "def" ||
   668 |     key.includes("def") ||
   669 |     key.includes("back") ||
   670 |     key.includes("centre back") ||
   671 |     key.includes("center back") ||
   672 |     key.includes("cb") ||
   673 |     key.includes("rb") ||
   674 |     key.includes("lb")
   675 |   ) {
   676 |     return "DEF";
   677 |   }
   678 | 
   679 |   return "";
   680 | }

   682 | function getPlayerRoleTagMapFromSnapshot(
   683 |   snapshot,
   684 |   canonicalName,
   685 |   playerKeyFor,
   686 |   formationMap = FORMATIONS_5,
   687 |   defaultFormationId = DEFAULT_FORMATION_ID_5
   688 | ) {
   689 |   const out = {};
   690 | 
   691 |   const formation =
   692 |     formationMap[snapshot?.formationId] || formationMap[defaultFormationId] || Object.values(formationMap)[0];
   693 | 
   694 |   const labelByPosId = new Map(
   695 |     (formation?.positions || []).map((pos) => [pos.id, pos.label || pos.id])
   696 |   );
   697 | 
   698 |   Object.entries(snapshot?.positions || {}).forEach(([posId, rawName]) => {
   699 |     const canonical = canonicalName(rawName);
   700 |     const key = playerKeyFor(canonical);
   701 |     if (!key) return;
   702 | 
   703 |     const posLabel = labelByPosId.get(posId) || posId;
   704 |     const roleTag = roleTagFromPosition(posLabel);
   705 | 
   706 |     if (roleTag) {
   707 |       out[key] = roleTag;
   708 |     }
   709 |   });
   710 | 
   711 |   return out;
   712 | }

   861 | function normalizeHexColor(v) {
   862 |   const raw = String(v || "").trim().replace(/[^#a-fA-F0-9]/g, "");
   863 |   if (!raw) return "";
   864 |   if (/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(raw)) return raw.toUpperCase();
   865 |   if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(raw)) return `#${raw.toUpperCase()}`;
   866 |   return "";
   867 | }
   868 | 
   869 | function hexToRgba(hex, alpha = 1) {
   870 |   const clean = String(hex || "").replace("#", "");
   871 |   if (!/^[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$/.test(clean)) return `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${alpha})`;
   872 |   const r = parseInt(clean.slice(0, 2), 16);
   873 |   const g = parseInt(clean.slice(2, 4), 16);
   874 |   const b = parseInt(clean.slice(4, 6), 16);
   875 |   return `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${alpha})`;
   876 | }
   877 | 
   878 | function colorNameToHex(name = "") {
   879 |   const key = String(name || "").trim().toLowerCase();
   880 | 
   881 |   if (!key) return "";
   882 |   if (key.includes("white")) return "#F8FAFC";
   883 |   if (key.includes("black")) return "#0F172A";
   884 |   if (key.includes("gold")) return "#D4A017";
   885 |   if (key.includes("yellow")) return "#EAB308";
   886 |   if (key.includes("orange")) return "#F97316";
   887 |   if (key.includes("pink")) return "#EC4899";
   888 |   if (key.includes("purple")) return "#A855F7";
   889 |   if (key.includes("navy")) return "#1E3A8A";
   890 |   if (key.includes("sky")) return "#38BDF8";
   891 |   if (key.includes("blue")) return "#2563EB";
   892 |   if (key.includes("red")) return "#DC2626";
   893 |   if (key.includes("green")) return "#22C55E";
   894 |   if (key.includes("slate") || key.includes("grey") || key.includes("gray"))
   895 |     return "#64748B";
   896 | 
   897 |   return "";
   898 | }

   900 | function getTeamAccent(team = {}) {
   901 |   const explicitHex = normalizeHexColor(
   902 |     team.teamColorHex || team.colorHex || team.teamColor || ""
   903 |   );
   904 |   const colorNameHex = colorNameToHex(
   905 |     team.teamColorName || team.colorName || ""
   906 |   );
   907 | 
   908 |   const accent = colorNameHex || explicitHex;
   909 | 
   910 |   if (accent) {
   911 |     return {
   912 |       dot: accent,
   913 |       soft: hexToRgba(accent, 0.18),
   914 |       border: hexToRgba(accent, 0.42),
   915 |       text: "#E5E7EB",
   916 |     };
   917 |   }
   918 | 
   919 |   return {
   920 |     dot: "#38bdf8",
   921 |     soft: "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16)",
   922 |     border: "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35)",
   923 |     text: "#e5e7eb",
   924 |   };
   925 | }

   930 | 
   931 |   // Friendly challenge teams should be shown by team name, not by shirt colour.
   932 |   // Example: Turf Kings vs Farmers FC, not Red vs Blue.
   933 |   if (label) return label.toUpperCase();
   934 |   if (explicit) return explicit.toUpperCase();
   935 | 
   936 |   return fallback;

  1034 | async function hardReset5v5MatchDoc(summaryInfo, matchSeconds) {
  1035 |   try {
  1036 |     const ref = getMatchDoc(db, MATCH_DOC_ID);
  1037 |     await setDoc(
  1038 |       ref,
  1039 |       {
  1040 |         matchMode: summaryInfo.matchMode || "5_V_5",
  1041 |         gameFormat: summaryInfo.gameFormat || "5_V_5",
  1042 |         playersPerSide: summaryInfo.playersPerSide || 5,
  1043 |         matchNumber: summaryInfo.matchNumber,
  1044 |         teamAId: summaryInfo.teamAId,
  1045 |         teamBId: summaryInfo.teamBId,
  1046 |         teamALabel: summaryInfo.teamALabel,
  1047 |         teamBLabel: summaryInfo.teamBLabel,
  1048 |         events: [],
  1049 |         goalsA: 0,
  1050 |         goalsB: 0,
  1051 |         finalSummary: null,
  1052 |         isFinished: false,
  1053 |         matchSeconds: matchSeconds ?? 0,
  1054 |         secondsLeft: matchSeconds ?? 0,
  1055 |         createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
  1056 |         lastUpdated: serverTimestamp(),
  1057 |       },
  1058 |       { merge: false }
  1059 |     );
  1060 |   } catch (err) {
  1061 |     console.error("⚠️ Failed to hard reset 5v5 match doc:", err);
  1062 |   }
  1063 | }
  1064 | 
  1065 | async function appendEventToFirestore(
  1066 |   event,
  1067 |   summaryInfo,
  1068 |   secondsLeft,
  1069 |   matchSeconds
  1070 | ) {
  1071 |   try {
  1072 |     const ref = getMatchDoc(db, MATCH_DOC_ID);
  1073 | 
  1074 |     const common = {
  1075 |       ...summaryInfo,
  1076 |       matchMode: summaryInfo.matchMode || "5_V_5",
  1077 |       gameFormat: summaryInfo.gameFormat || "5_V_5",
  1078 |       playersPerSide: summaryInfo.playersPerSide || 5,
  1079 |       matchSeconds: matchSeconds ?? 0,
  1080 |       secondsLeft:
  1081 |         typeof secondsLeft === "number" ? Math.max(secondsLeft, 0) : null,
  1082 |       isFinished: false,
  1083 |       lastUpdated: serverTimestamp(),
  1084 |     };
  1085 | 
  1086 |     try {
  1087 |       await updateDoc(ref, {
  1088 |         events: arrayUnion(event),
  1089 |         ...common,
  1090 |       });
  1091 |     } catch (_) {
  1092 |       await setDoc(
  1093 |         ref,
  1094 |         {
  1095 |           events: [event],
  1096 |           createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
  1097 |           ...common,
  1098 |         },
  1099 |         { merge: true }
  1100 |       );
  1101 |     }
  1102 |   } catch (err) {
  1103 |     console.error("⚠️ Failed to mirror event to Firestore:", err);
  1104 |   }
  1105 | }

  1225 |             ? "radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, #f59e0b, #78350f)"

  1236 |           <span className="live-bench-avatar-fallback">
  1237 |             {String(name || "?").charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
  1238 |           </span>
  1239 |         )}
  1240 |       </span>
  1241 | 
  1242 |       <span className={isSub ? "live-bench-chip-text is-sub" : ""}>

  1250 | function PlayerChoiceGrid({
  1251 |   title,
  1252 |   players,
  1253 |   selectedName,
  1254 |   onSelect,
  1255 |   displayCompactPlayerName,
  1256 |   getPlayerPhoto,
  1257 |   team = null,
  1258 |   guestSnapshotChecker = null,
  1259 |   disabled = false,
  1260 | }) {
  1261 | 
  1262 |   const accent = team ? getTeamAccent(team) : null;
  1263 | 
  1264 |   return (
  1265 |     <div
  1266 |       className={`field-row ${
  1267 |         accent ? "fanm-team-player-choice" : ""
  1268 |       }`}

  1270 |         accent
  1271 |           ? {
  1272 |               "--player-team-color": accent.dot,
  1273 |               "--player-team-soft": accent.soft,

  1296 |             const isGuest = guestSnapshotChecker
  1297 |               ? guestSnapshotChecker(rawName)
  1298 |               : false;
  1299 |             const photoData = getPlayerPhoto(rawName);
  1300 |

  1302 |               <PlayerBenchChip
  1303 |                 key={`${rawName}-${isSub ? "sub" : "field"}-${
  1304 |                   roleTag || "norole"
  1305 |                 }`}
  1306 |                   name={displayCompactPlayerName(rawName)}
  1307 |                   isSelected={isSelected}
  1308 |                   onClick={() => {
  1309 |                     if (isEntryDisabled) return;
  1310 |                     onSelect(isSelected ? "" : rawName);
  1311 |                   }}
  1312 |                   photoData={photoData}
  1313 |                   disabled={isEntryDisabled}
  1314 |                   suffix={isGuest ? " (Guest)" : ""}
  1315 |                   isSub={isSub}
  1316 |                 roleTag={roleTag}
  1317 |               />
  1318 |             );
  1319 |           })}
  1320 |         </div>
  1321 |       )}
  1322 |     </div>
  1323 |   );
  1324 | }
  1325 | 
  1326 | function LineupBoard({
  1327 |   title,
  1328 |   team = null,
  1329 |   lineup,
  1330 |   setLineup,
  1331 |   registeredPlayers,
  1332 |   canonicalName,
  1333 |   displayCompactPlayerName,
  1334 |   playerKeyFor,
  1335 |   getPlayerPhoto,
  1336 |   formationMap = FORMATIONS_5,
  1337 |   defaultFormationId = DEFAULT_FORMATION_ID_5,
  1338 |   protectedVacancies = {},
  1339 |   disabled = false,
  1340 | }) {
  1341 |   const formation =
  1342 |     formationMap[lineup?.formationId] || formationMap[defaultFormationId] || Object.values(formationMap)[0];
  1343 |   const [selectedPlayer, setSelectedPlayer] = useState(null);
  1344 |   const [guestName, setGuestName] = useState("");
  1345 | 
  1346 |   useEffect(() => {
  1347 |     setSelectedPlayer(null);
  1348 |   }, [lineup?.formationId]);
  1349 | 
  1350 |   const allRegistered = uniquePlayersNormalized(
  1351 |     registeredPlayers || [],
  1352 |     canonicalName,
  1353 |     playerKeyFor
  1354 |   );
  1355 | 
  1356 |   const sanitizedLineup = useMemo(() => {
  1357 |     const nextLineup =
  1358 |       sanitizeLiveLineupToRegisteredPlayers(
  1359 |         lineup,
  1360 |         allRegistered,
  1361 |         canonicalName,
  1362 |         playerKeyFor,
  1363 |         formationMap,
  1364 |         defaultFormationId,
  1365 |         {
  1366 |           preservePositions: true,
  1367 |         }
  1368 |       );
  1369 | 
  1370 |     /*
  1371 |      * The sanitizer may clean player and bench data, but it must
  1372 |      * never decide who enters the pitch during a live match.
  1373 |      *
  1374 |      * Preserve the referee's exact position assignments, including
  1375 |      * deliberately empty positions.
  1376 |      */
  1377 |     const allowedPlayerKeys = new Set(
  1378 |       [
  1379 |         ...(allRegistered || []),
  1380 |         ...(lineup?.guestPlayers || []),
  1381 |       ]
  1382 |         .map((name) => canonicalName(name))
  1383 |         .filter(Boolean)
  1384 |         .map((name) => playerKeyFor(name))
  1385 |     );
  1386 | 
  1387 |     const nextPositions = {};
  1388 | 
  1389 |     formation.positions.forEach((position) => {
  1390 |       const rawAssignedName = canonicalName(
  1391 |         lineup?.positions?.[position.id] || ""
  1392 |       );
  1393 | 
  1394 |       nextPositions[position.id] =
  1395 |         rawAssignedName &&
  1396 |         allowedPlayerKeys.has(
  1397 |           playerKeyFor(rawAssignedName)
  1398 |         )
  1399 |           ? rawAssignedName
  1400 |           : null;
  1401 |     });
  1402 | 
  1403 |     Object.entries(protectedVacancies || {}).forEach(
  1404 |       ([positionId, vacancy]) => {
  1405 |         const manuallyAssignedName =
  1406 |           canonicalName(
  1407 |             lineup?.positions?.[positionId] || ""
  1408 |           );
  1409 | 
  1410 |         /*
  1411 |          * Permanent and active temporary vacancies stay locked.
  1412 |          *
  1413 |          * An expired temporary vacancy stays empty until the referee
  1414 |          * manually selects a bench player and taps that green slot.
  1415 |          */
  1416 |         if (
  1417 |           vacancy?.locked ||
  1418 |           (
  1419 |             vacancy?.replacementAllowed &&
  1420 |             !manuallyAssignedName
  1421 |           )
  1422 |         ) {
  1423 |           nextPositions[positionId] = null;
  1424 |         }
  1425 |       }
  1426 |     );
  1427 | 
  1428 |     const assignedKeys = new Set(
  1429 |       Object.values(nextPositions)
  1430 |         .filter(Boolean)
  1431 |         .map((name) => playerKeyFor(name))
  1432 |     );
  1433 | 
  1434 |     const nextBenchSnapshot =
  1435 |       uniquePlayersNormalized(
  1436 |         [
  1437 |           ...(lineup?.benchSnapshot || []),
  1438 |           ...(nextLineup?.benchSnapshot || []),
  1439 |         ],
  1440 |         canonicalName,
  1441 |         playerKeyFor
  1442 |       ).filter(
  1443 |         (name) =>
  1444 |           !assignedKeys.has(playerKeyFor(name))
  1445 |       );
  1446 | 
  1447 |     return {
  1448 |       ...nextLineup,
  1449 |       positions: nextPositions,
  1450 |       benchSnapshot: nextBenchSnapshot,
  1451 |       onFieldPlayerCount: Object.values(
  1452 |         nextPositions
  1453 |       ).filter(Boolean).length,
  1454 |     };
  1455 |   }, [
  1456 |     lineup,
  1457 |     allRegistered,
  1458 |     canonicalName,
  1459 |     playerKeyFor,
  1460 |     formation,
  1461 |     formationMap,
  1462 |     defaultFormationId,
  1463 |     protectedVacancies,
  1464 |   ]);
  1465 | 
  1466 | 
  1467 |   const assignedNames = Object.values(lineup?.positions || {})
  1468 |     .map((name) => canonicalName(name))
  1469 |     .filter(Boolean);
  1470 | 
  1471 |   const assignedKeys = new Set(assignedNames.map((name) => playerKeyFor(name)));
  1472 | 
  1473 |   const guestPlayers = uniquePlayersNormalized(
  1474 |     lineup?.guestPlayers || [],
  1475 |     canonicalName,
  1476 |     playerKeyFor
  1477 |   );
  1478 | 
  1479 |   const sanitizedBenchRegistered = uniquePlayersNormalized(
  1480 |     lineup?.benchSnapshot || [],
  1481 |     canonicalName,
  1482 |     playerKeyFor
  1483 |   ).filter((p) => !assignedKeys.has(playerKeyFor(p)));
  1484 | 
  1485 |   const sanitizedGuestBench = uniquePlayersNormalized(
  1486 |     guestPlayers,
  1487 |     canonicalName,
  1488 |     playerKeyFor
  1489 |   ).filter((p) => !assignedKeys.has(playerKeyFor(p)));
  1490 | 
  1491 |   const benchList = uniquePlayersNormalized(
  1492 |     [...sanitizedGuestBench, ...sanitizedBenchRegistered],
  1493 |     canonicalName,
  1494 |     playerKeyFor
  1495 |   ).filter((p) => !assignedKeys.has(playerKeyFor(p)));
  1496 | 
  1497 |   const handleBenchClick = (playerName) => {
  1498 |     if (disabled) return;
  1499 | 
  1500 |     if (
  1501 |       selectedPlayer &&
  1502 |       selectedPlayer.from === "bench" &&
  1503 |       selectedPlayer.name === playerName
  1504 |     ) {
  1505 |       setSelectedPlayer(null);
  1506 |       return;
  1507 |     }
  1508 | 
  1509 |     setSelectedPlayer({ from: "bench", name: playerName });
  1510 |   };
  1511 | 
  1512 |   const handlePitchClick = (posId) => {
  1513 |     if (disabled) return;
  1514 | 
  1515 |     const vacancy =
  1516 |       protectedVacancies?.[posId] || null;
  1517 | 
  1518 |     if (vacancy?.locked) {
  1519 |       setSelectedPlayer(null);
  1520 |       return;
  1521 |     }
  1522 | 
  1523 |     const currentAtPos =
  1524 |       lineup?.positions?.[posId] || null;
  1525 | 
  1526 |     if (!selectedPlayer) {
  1527 |       if (!currentAtPos) return;
  1528 |       setSelectedPlayer({ from: "pitch", name: currentAtPos, posId });
  1529 |       return;
  1530 |     }
  1531 | 
  1532 |     const newPositions = { ...(lineup?.positions || {}) };
  1533 |     let nextBenchSnapshot = [...sanitizedBenchRegistered];
  1534 | 
  1535 |     if (selectedPlayer.from === "bench") {
  1536 |       const incoming = canonicalName(selectedPlayer.name);
  1537 |       const outgoing = canonicalName(currentAtPos);
  1538 | 
  1539 |       Object.keys(newPositions).forEach((key) => {
  1540 |         if (playerKeyFor(newPositions[key]) === playerKeyFor(incoming)) {
  1541 |           newPositions[key] = null;
  1542 |         }
  1543 |       });
  1544 | 
  1545 |       newPositions[posId] = incoming;
  1546 |       nextBenchSnapshot = removePlayerByKey(
  1547 |         nextBenchSnapshot,
  1548 |         incoming,
  1549 |         canonicalName,
  1550 |         playerKeyFor
  1551 |       );
  1552 | 
  1553 |       if (outgoing) {
  1554 |         nextBenchSnapshot = movePlayerToFront(
  1555 |           nextBenchSnapshot,
  1556 |           outgoing,
  1557 |           canonicalName,
  1558 |           playerKeyFor
  1559 |         );
  1560 |       }
  1561 |     } else {
  1562 |       const fromPos = selectedPlayer.posId;
  1563 |       const fromName = canonicalName(selectedPlayer.name);
  1564 |       const toName = canonicalName(currentAtPos);
  1565 | 
  1566 |       newPositions[fromPos] = toName || null;
  1567 |       newPositions[posId] = fromName;
  1568 |     }
  1569 | 
  1570 |     const nextAssignedKeys = new Set(
  1571 |       Object.values(newPositions)
  1572 |         .map((name) => canonicalName(name))
  1573 |         .filter(Boolean)
  1574 |         .map((name) => playerKeyFor(name))
  1575 |     );
  1576 | 
  1577 |     setLineup((prev) => ({
  1578 |       ...prev,
  1579 |       positions: newPositions,
  1580 |       benchSnapshot: uniquePlayersNormalized(
  1581 |         nextBenchSnapshot,
  1582 |         canonicalName,
  1583 |         playerKeyFor
  1584 |       ).filter((p) => !nextAssignedKeys.has(playerKeyFor(p))),
  1585 |     }));
  1586 | 
  1587 |     setSelectedPlayer(null);
  1588 |   };
  1589 | 
  1590 |   const handleGuestAdd = () => {
  1591 |     if (disabled) return;
  1592 | 
  1593 |     const clean = canonicalName(guestName);
  1594 |     if (!clean) return;
  1595 | 
  1596 |     if (assignedKeys.has(playerKeyFor(clean))) {
  1597 |       setGuestName("");
  1598 |       return;
  1599 |     }
  1600 | 
  1601 |     const knownClubPlayer = canonicalName(clean);
  1602 | 
  1603 |     const registeredMatch = allRegistered.find(
  1604 |       (p) => playerKeyFor(p) === playerKeyFor(clean)
  1605 |     );
  1606 | 
  1607 |     if (registeredMatch) {
  1608 |       setLineup((prev) => ({
  1609 |         ...prev,
  1610 |         benchSnapshot: movePlayerToFront(
  1611 |           prev?.benchSnapshot || [],
  1612 |           registeredMatch,
  1613 |           canonicalName,
  1614 |           playerKeyFor
  1615 |         ),
  1616 |       }));
  1617 |       setGuestName("");
  1618 |       return;
  1619 |     }
  1620 | 
  1621 |     setLineup((prev) => ({
  1622 |       ...prev,
  1623 |       guestPlayers: uniquePlayersNormalized(
  1624 |         [...(prev?.guestPlayers || []), clean],
  1625 |         canonicalName,
  1626 |         playerKeyFor
  1627 |       ),
  1628 |     }));
  1629 | 
  1630 |     setGuestName("");
  1631 |   };
  1632 | 
  1633 |   const handleRemoveGuest = (name) => {
  1634 |     if (disabled) return;
  1635 | 
  1636 |     setLineup((prev) => {
  1637 |       const nextGuests = (prev?.guestPlayers || []).filter(
  1638 |         (g) => playerKeyFor(g) !== playerKeyFor(name)
  1639 |       );
  1640 | 
  1641 |       const nextPositions = { ...(prev?.positions || {}) };
  1642 |       Object.keys(nextPositions).forEach((k) => {
  1643 |         if (playerKeyFor(nextPositions[k]) === playerKeyFor(name)) {
  1644 |           nextPositions[k] = null;
  1645 |         }
  1646 |       });
  1647 | 
  1648 |       const cleanedBenchSnapshot = removePlayerByKey(
  1649 |         prev?.benchSnapshot || [],
  1650 |         name,
  1651 |         canonicalName,
  1652 |         playerKeyFor
  1653 |       );
  1654 | 
  1655 |       return {
  1656 |         ...prev,
  1657 |         positions: nextPositions,
  1658 |         guestPlayers: nextGuests,
  1659 |         benchSnapshot: cleanedBenchSnapshot,
  1660 |       };
  1661 |     });
  1662 | 
  1663 |     setSelectedPlayer(null);
  1664 |   };
  1665 | 
  1666 |   return (
  1667 |     <div className="live-lineup-column">
  1668 |       <h3 className="live-bench-title">
  1669 |         <TeamColorBadge team={team || { label: title }} fallback={title || "OTHER TEAM"} />
  1670 |       </h3>
  1671 | 
  1672 |       <div className="pitch-wrapper">
  1673 |         <div className="pitch" style={{ maxWidth: "100%" }}>
  1674 |           <div className="pitch-centre-circle" />
  1675 |           <div className="pitch-half-line" />
  1676 |           <div className="pitch-box pitch-box-top" />
  1677 |           <div className="pitch-box pitch-box-bottom" />
  1678 | 
  1679 |           {formation.positions.map((pos) => {
  1680 |             const name =
  1681 |               lineup?.positions?.[pos.id] || "";
  1682 | 
  1683 |             const vacancy =
  1684 |               protectedVacancies?.[pos.id] || null;
  1685 | 
  1686 |             const isLockedVacancy =
  1687 |               Boolean(vacancy?.locked);

  1893 | function formatSeconds(s) {
  1894 |   const v = typeof s === "number" && !Number.isNaN(s) ? s : 0;
  1895 |   const m = Math.floor(v / 60)
  1896 |     .toString()
  1897 |     .padStart(2, "0");
  1898 |   const sec = (v % 60).toString().padStart(2, "0");
  1899 |   return `${m}:${sec}`;
  1900 | }
  1901 | 
  1902 | function formatEventClock(totalMatchSeconds, secondsLeft, eventTimeSeconds) {
  1903 |   const elapsed =
  1904 |     typeof eventTimeSeconds === "number"
  1905 |       ? eventTimeSeconds
  1906 |       : (totalMatchSeconds || 0) - (secondsLeft || 0);
  1907 |   return formatSeconds(elapsed);
  1908 | }
  1909 | 
  1910 | function getRotationDue(matchSeconds, secondsLeft) {
  1911 |   const elapsed = Math.max((matchSeconds || 0) - (secondsLeft || 0), 0);
  1912 |   const nextBoundary =
  1913 |     Math.floor(elapsed / ROTATION_INTERVAL_SECONDS) * ROTATION_INTERVAL_SECONDS +
  1914 |     ROTATION_INTERVAL_SECONDS;
  1915 |   const remaining = Math.max(nextBoundary - elapsed, 0);
  1916 | 
  1917 |   return {
  1918 |     elapsed,
  1919 |     remaining,
  1920 |     nextBoundary,
  1921 |   };
  1922 | }
  1923 | 
  1924 | function getLocalDateKey(dateInput = new Date()) {
  1925 |   const d = dateInput instanceof Date ? dateInput : new Date(dateInput || Date.now());
  1926 |   const safe = Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? new Date() : d;
  1927 |   const year = safe.getFullYear();
  1928 |   const month = String(safe.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  1929 |   const day = String(safe.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  1930 |   return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
  1931 | }
  1932 | 
  1933 | function normalizeFormatKey(gameFormat = "5_V_5") {
  1934 |   const raw = String(gameFormat || "5_V_5").trim().toLowerCase();
  1935 |   if (raw.includes("7")) return "7v7";
  1936 |   if (raw.includes("6")) return "6v6";
  1937 |   return "5v5";
  1938 | }

   196 | function normalizeHexColor(v) {
   197 |   const raw = String(v || "").trim().replace(/[^#a-fA-F0-9]/g, "");
   198 |   if (!raw) return "";
   199 |   if (/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(raw)) return raw.toUpperCase();
   200 |   if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(raw)) return `#${raw.toUpperCase()}`;
   201 |   return raw.toUpperCase();
   202 | }

   208 | function hexToRgba(hex, alpha = 1) {
   209 |   const clean = String(hex || "").replace("#", "");
   210 |   if (!/^[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$/.test(clean)) return `rgba(34, 197, 94, ${alpha})`;
   211 |   const r = parseInt(clean.slice(0, 2), 16);
   212 |   const g = parseInt(clean.slice(2, 4), 16);
   213 |   const b = parseInt(clean.slice(4, 6), 16);
   214 |   return `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${alpha})`;
   215 | }

  1839 | function normalizeMatchSecondsValue(value, fallbackSeconds) {

  1896 | function buildClubOfficialScheduledFinishISO(playTime, startISO) {
  1897 |   const start = new Date(startISO || Date.now());
  1898 |   const match = String(playTime || "").match(
  1899 |     /(?:^|\D)([01]?\d|2[0-3]):([0-5]\d)(?:\D|$)/
  1900 |   );
  1901 | 
  1902 |   if (!match || !Number.isFinite(start.getTime())) return null;
  1903 | 
  1904 |   const scheduledStart = new Date(start);
  1905 |   scheduledStart.setHours(Number(match[1]), Number(match[2]), 0, 0);
  1906 | 
  1907 |   const scheduledFinish = new Date(scheduledStart);
  1908 |   scheduledFinish.setMinutes(scheduledFinish.getMinutes() + 60);
  1909 |

  1913 | function buildClubScheduledFinishISO(playTime, startISO, fallbackSeconds) {
  1914 |   const start = new Date(startISO || Date.now());
  1915 | 
  1916 |   if (!Number.isFinite(start.getTime())) {
  1917 |     return addSecondsToISO(startISO, fallbackSeconds);
  1918 |   }
  1919 | 
  1920 |   const officialFinishISO = buildClubOfficialScheduledFinishISO(
  1921 |     playTime,
  1922 |     startISO
  1923 |   );
  1924 | 
  1925 |   if (!officialFinishISO) {
  1926 |     const recommended = roundDateToNearestQuarterHour(
  1927 |       new Date(start.getTime() + Math.max(0, Number(fallbackSeconds || 3600)) * 1000)
  1928 |     );
  1929 | 
  1930 |     return recommended?.toISOString() || addSecondsToISO(startISO, fallbackSeconds);
  1931 |   }
  1932 | 
  1933 |   const officialFinish = new Date(officialFinishISO);
  1934 |   const scheduledStart = new Date(officialFinish);
  1935 |   scheduledStart.setMinutes(scheduledStart.getMinutes() - 60);
  1936 | 
  1937 |   // Treat kickoff as part of the scheduled session when it begins
  1938 |   // no more than 30 minutes before the scheduled start and no more
  1939 |   // than 30 minutes after it.
  1940 |   const earliestScheduledKickoff = scheduledStart.getTime() - 30 * 60 * 1000;
  1941 |   const latestScheduledKickoff = scheduledStart.getTime() + 30 * 60 * 1000;
  1942 |   const kickoffIsNearSchedule =
  1943 |     start.getTime() >= earliestScheduledKickoff &&
  1944 |     start.getTime() <= latestScheduledKickoff;
  1945 | 
  1946 |   if (kickoffIsNearSchedule && officialFinish.getTime() > start.getTime()) {
  1947 |     return officialFinish.toISOString();
  1948 |   }
  1949 | 
  1950 |   const recommended = roundDateToNearestQuarterHour(
  1951 |     new Date(start.getTime() + 60 * 60 * 1000)
  1952 |   );
  1953 | 
  1954 |   return recommended?.toISOString() || addSecondsToISO(startISO, fallbackSeconds);
  1955 | }

  2019 | function parseClubWeeklyWindow(text) {
  2020 |   const raw = String(text || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  2021 |   if (!raw) return null;
  2022 | 
  2023 |   const dayMap = {
  2024 |     sunday: 0, sundays: 0,
  2025 |     monday: 1, mondays: 1,
  2026 |     tuesday: 2, tuesdays: 2,
  2027 |     wednesday: 3, wednesdays: 3,
  2028 |     thursday: 4, thursdays: 4,
  2029 |     friday: 5, fridays: 5,
  2030 |     saturday: 6, saturdays: 6,
  2031 |   };
  2032 | 
  2033 |   const dayKey = Object.keys(dayMap).find((key) => raw.includes(key));
  2034 |   const timeMatch = raw.match(/(\d{1,2})[:h](\d{2})(?:\s*[–-]\s*(\d{1,2})[:h](\d{2}))?/);
  2035 | 
  2036 |   if (!dayKey || !timeMatch) return null;
  2037 | 
  2038 |   const [, sh, sm, rawEh, rawEm] = timeMatch;
  2039 |   const eh = rawEh || String(Number(sh) + 2);
  2040 |   const em = rawEm || sm;
  2041 |   return {
  2042 |     day: dayMap[dayKey],
  2043 |     startMinutes: Number(sh) * 60 + Number(sm),
  2044 |     endMinutes: Number(eh) * 60 + Number(em),
  2045 |   };
  2046 | }
  2047 | 
  2048 | function isInsideClubWeeklyWindow(weeklyPlayTime, now = new Date()) {
  2049 |   const windowInfo = parseClubWeeklyWindow(weeklyPlayTime);
  2050 |   if (!windowInfo) return false;
  2051 | 
  2052 |   const currentDay = now.getDay();
  2053 |   const currentMinutes = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
  2054 | 
  2055 |   // 30-minute grace before and after the official window.
  2056 |   return (
  2057 |     currentDay === windowInfo.day &&
  2058 |     currentMinutes >= windowInfo.startMinutes - 30 &&
  2059 |     currentMinutes <= windowInfo.endMinutes + 30
  2060 |   );
  2061 | }
